value.rationale: The motivating work uses this very example to justify square-summability for worst-case mean-square convergence, and states the weaker sufficient condition p>1 at b=1/2. The exact cutoff p=1/2 (sigma B=1), explicit positive borderline residual, and almost-sure-to-zero versus diverging-mean-square dichotomy identify a material stability boundary and show precisely why expectation-based diagnostics can give the opposite verdict from typical trajectories. The quantitative result is naturally parameterized and requires no broader theorem.
